schema_note: Each entry uses the 'signature' shape from docs/oracle/identity/game-identity.schema.json. class=style may be learned from; class=expression is never copied.

magic-the-gathering.description: The same card exists in standard, borderless, extended-art, showcase and foil treatments; the variant is the collectible.
Collector number, rarity, set code, language and artist in a machine-readable strip at the bottom.
A small holographic stamp on rare and up as an authenticity and value cue.
Magic's frame art, mana and set symbols, card back and typefaces.

pokemon-tcg.description: Rarity told by symbol shape (circle, diamond, star, multi-star), not colour alone.
Costs are icons a pre-reader can count; damage numbers are large.
Top-tier cards run the illustration behind the whole card with text floating on it; textured foil you can feel.
The creatures, energy symbols, ball iconography, frames and card back.

hearthstone.description: The art window's shape tells the card type before reading.
Face-down pack cards glow their rarity colour on hover before the flip.
Golden and fully animated variants keep the layout and animate the art.
Cards lift, enlarge, travel and slam with dust and sound; nothing teleports.
The stone-and-metal frame art, gem art, legendary dragon, fonts and card back.

gwent.description: Nearly the whole face is art with one number; name and ability on inspect.
Animated premium cards keep the same face so they stay readable.
Gwent's art, frames and faction marks.

legends-of-runeterra.description: No watermark behind text; region icon moved to a corner for readability (patch 2.2).
Frame colour means one thing; colour is never the only cue, for colour-blind players.
A champion card levels up mid-game into a new face with a full-screen moment.
Runeterra's champions, regions, frames and icons.

marvel-snap.description: Cost and power only on the face; ability text on inspect.
Upgrading walks the same card up a visual ladder: border, frame break, 3D parallax, animated, logo.
Finishes (foil, prism, ink, gold) and flares (particles around the card) are separate collectible axes.
Marvel characters, card art, logos, and Snap's exact tier names and colour sequence.

slay-the-spire.description: Attack, skill and power cards have differently shaped art windows.
Upgraded cards get a plus and changed numbers in a highlight colour.
The art, frames, card names and text.

inscryption.description: Cards are diegetic props handled on a table by a first-person camera.
Abilities are icons (sigils) rather than sentences.
The woodcut art, sigil designs, the table and the horror tone.

9-kings.description: A played card turns into a building on the plot grid, then the world plays out.
Cards are a picture and a role with very few words.
9 Kings' pixel art, kings and card content.

balatro.description: Cards sway idly and tilt in 3D toward the cursor.
Scoring cards pop in sequence with rising pitch.
Editions (foil, holographic, polychrome, negative) are shaders over the same art.
Balatro's art, jokers and its overall CRT look.

premium-physical.description: 63 x 88 mm trim, 3 mm bleed and safe, 300-600 ppi, CMYK PDF/X-4, black-core 300-330 gsm.
Holofoil laminate, cold foil, spot UV, etched foil, embossing, gilded edges, holo stamp.
